prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless technical-textile background texture for a production sports-health dashboard
Primary request: Recreate only the deep graphite textile material visible in the approved Kinetic Tape Atlas mock as a clean reusable production texture. It must be a truly seamless square tile, suitable for CSS background-repeat in every direction.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved visual reference for palette, subtle material character, and quiet technical-athletic mood only; do not reproduce any interface content.
Scene/backdrop: flat, front-facing macro material plate filling the entire frame edge to edge
Style/medium: high-resolution photoreal material scan, matte and understated
Composition/framing: orthographic, uniform scale and density across the full square; tileable left-to-right and top-to-bottom with perfectly matching edges; no perspective, no focal point, no vignette
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse even illumination, near-black graphite, extremely low contrast, quiet enough behind small white UI text
Color palette: charcoal black and graphite only, no blue, coral, lime, warm highlights, or color cast
Materials/textures: very subtle technical knit crossed with fine ripstop weave, restrained woven depth, tiny fibers, soft matte finish; no large seams or defects
Constraints: no symbols, no typography, no logos, no interface, no objects, no body, no tape, no gradients, no shadows, no border, no rounded corners, no letterboxing, no watermark; preserve an even luminance field; designed as a seamless repeating tile at 1024 x 1024 or larger
Avoid: dramatic fabric folds, denim, carbon fiber, leather, glossy nylon, obvious checkerboard, moire, high-contrast threads, grunge, dust, scratches, directional light, center hotspot, edge darkening
